Point a program's aliases at versions

Usage:
  kaab programs alias [command]

Available Commands:
  set         Point ALIAS at VERSION (alias latest is managed by publishing)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for alias

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab programs alias [command] --help" for more information about a command.
